summary.en: Israeli air strikes have killed senior Hamas security officials in Gaza, while Israeli forces have cut $90 million from border community recovery budgets to fund defense and detained a Polish lawmaker ahead of a West Bank visit. Gaza health officials have issued an alert over a rising meningitis epidemic, and a night of arson has been linked to Israeli Jewish terrorism. Israel's top court described West Bank settlers as acting like militias, and the United Nations warned that the war has undone 77 years of human development in Gaza. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels luftangrep har drept høytstående Hamas-sikkerhetsoffiserer i Gaza, mens israelske styrker har kuttet 90 millioner dollar fra gjenoppbyggingsbudsjettene til grenseområdene for å finansiere forsvaret og har fengslet en polsk lovgiver før et besøk i Vestbredden. Gazas helsemyndigheter har gitt en advarsel om en økende meningitt-epidemi, og en natt med brannstiftelse er knyttet til israelsk jødisk terrorisme. Israels høyesterett beskrev bosettere på Vestbredden som opptrådte som milits, og FN advarte om at krigen har tilbakestilt 77 år med menneskelig utvikling i Gaza. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
